name: bench-deals
description: Read and create BenchAGI deals and read the pipeline summary through the existing /api/v1/chassis deal routes. Calls use Chassis API keys via X-API-Key; cowork bearer tokens are not valid for these routes. The tenant is vended by the key — instanceId is derived server-side and any client-supplied instanceId is ignored.

BENCH_CHASSIS_API_KEY.description: Chassis API key in bench_<instanceId>_<secret> format.
BENCH_CHASSIS_API_KEY.missing_message: BENCH_CHASSIS_API_KEY is required for bench-deals MCP calls. Set it to a Chassis API key in bench_<instanceId>_<secret> format.

auth.missing_message: BENCH_CHASSIS_API_KEY is required for bench-deals MCP calls. Set it to a Chassis API key in bench_<instanceId>_<secret> format.
auth.invalid_bearer_message: Looks like you passed a Bearer token. The deals MCP needs BENCH_CHASSIS_API_KEY (format bench_<instanceId>_<secret>). Cowork tokens are for /api/v1/cowork/*, not /chassis/*.

tools.name: deals_list
tools.description: List deals for the authenticated instance. Optional filters: status (comma-separated stage ids, max 10), assignedTo (user id), limit (default 50, max 200). Requires scope deals:read.

status.description: Comma-separated deal stage ids, e.g. 'estimate,job_approved'. Stages: introduction, inspection, claim_session, adjuster_meeting, estimate, job_approved, installation_handoff, closed_won, closed_lost, no_damage.

assignedTo.description: Return only deals where this user id is in assignedTo.

limit.description: Max deals to return (default 50, capped at 200).

tools.name: deal_get
tools.description: Fetch a single deal by id (returns 404 if it is not in this instance). Requires scope deals:read.

tools.name: deal_create
tools.description: Create a deal for the authenticated instance. One of customerName or title is required. The tenant is server-derived from the key (any instanceId in the body is ignored). Requires scope deals:write.

customerName.description: Customer / account name (required if title is absent).

title.description: Deal title (required if customerName is absent).

estimatedValue.description: Estimated deal value. Falls back to `value` if omitted.

tools.name: pipeline_summary
tools.description: Pipeline stage summary for the authenticated instance: per-stage count, totalValue, and probability-weightedValue, plus grand totals. Requires scope pipeline:read (falls back to deals:read).
